page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Ainaf.

main_text.l: & omnia expendens diligenter, sic re-
peri: Cùm concors cum ordinibus agri
vicini civitas ageret, ac foedera in cer-
tos annos percussa identidem proroga-
ret, prope ut una utrorumque Respubli-
ca videretur, ex consensu sociorum eos
profluxisse, rectius atque aequalius ex-
pediundi juris, & tenendae concordiae,
conservandaeque quietis publicae causa:
electos esse ex spectatissimis & integerri-
mis quibusque in civitate, interdum e-
tiam ex iis, qui e nobilitate agrariâ in ur-
bem commigrarant, & jus civitatis acqui-
serant: quinos & quinos in collegio fuis-
se perannos amplius ix[?], eosque incerta ra-
tione, prout operam suam probassent, aut
grati Reipubl. essent, aut casus daret,
vel permutatos successoribus: vel per
annos complures, quod erat frequens,
continuatos: praetoriam potestatem te-
nuisse in omnes per agrum habitantes,
eaque usos totius provinciae, id est, agri
& civitatis nomine, edictisque nomen
senatus cum nomine suo subscripsisse, &
civitatis sigillo edicta & literas signasse:
jus dixisse iis, qui fraudem sibi fieri apud

page.notes: The scan is slightly cropped at the left and bottom; a faint library stamp at the bottom right was left out. "amplius ix" is hard to read (possibly "lx") and is marked [?]. "agrariâ" is printed with a mark over the a, kept as shown. The word "successoribus:" is printed with a colon-like point before "vel" and kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s; u/v and i/j are normalised.
